ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-G
in the area bound by:

      South Peoria Drive; West 63rd Street; South Halsted Street; and the north right-of-way
      line of the Chicago Transit Authority Railway,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Stephanie D. Coleman
                                                          Alderman, 16h Ward




Common Address:
815-859 W. 63rd Street
6300-6312 S. Halsted Street
